## Description

Extracts the month of year (1-12) from a date, using the [query time zone](/reference/query-languages/esql/directives/set.md#esql-time_zone). Equivalent to `DATE_EXTRACT("month_of_year", date)`. This function accepts a `date` or `date_nanos` value. Unix timestamps in seconds must be converted first. For example: `TO_DATETIME(start * 1000)`. This extract is cyclic: `MONTH(ts) > 3` is not rewritten to a timestamp range.
